question: What belongs to the full-hearted who desires no fruit?
premises: full-hearted, he desires neither fruit nor name
inference: Desirelessness inherits the goddess who forms worlds — through unlimiting.
uncertainties: avaccheda-varjana (abandoning limitation) as the operative turn
plain_english: But he who is full-hearted and desires neither fruit nor name — his is the world-forming goddess, by abandonment of limitation.
